system.name: COMET
system.one_liner: an inference framework enabling practical W4A4KV4 quantized serving of LLMs via a mixed-precision GEMM kernel

content.key_idea: COMET-W4Ax computes GEMM at tile granularity with per-block INT4/INT8 mixed precision, converts INT4 to INT8 on CUDA cores for W4A8 tiles, and uses a double-buffered software pipeline to overlap loading, dequantization, and tensor-core computation.

summary: COMET is an inference framework enabling practical W4A4KV4 serving of large language models by fully exploiting INT4 tensor cores. This three-panel figure details the design of its COMET-W4Ax kernel. Panel (a) shows tile-based GEMM computing: the activation tensor is split into blocks at different precisions (INT4 vs. INT8, per FMPQ), each block's tiles invoking a thread block, with a Reduction step accumulating results across tiles. Panel (b) shows how different SMs issue W4A4 (direct mma) versus W4A8 (requiring INT4-to-INT8 conversion on CUDA cores before mma) GEMM instructions simultaneously, highlighting that W4A4's faster tensor cores can sit underutilized waiting on W4A8 SMs. Panel (c) shows the resulting SIMT-enhanced software pipeline: double on-chip buffers (W0/W1, A0/A1) let cp.async global-memory loads, permutation/dequantization, and INT4/INT8 mma computation overlap across iterations, hiding data-loading and conversion latency behind tensor-core compute.
summary_zh: 该图分三部分示COMET-W4Ax内核：(a)混合精度分块GEMM；(b)不同SM发射W4A4/W4A8指令，W4A8需CUDA核转换INT4为INT8；(c)双缓冲流水线重叠加载与张量核计算。
notes: This is a dense three-panel PowerPoint-authored figure (per the index's tool metadata); fine-grained wiring inside panels (b) and (c) is read from the low-resolution preview and may not capture every label exactly.
